title: Cratis Stage Event Model
description: The shared, JSON-friendly intermediate format for a Cratis event model. Every generation source (Prologue extraction, AI generation, and JSON file import) produces this format, which is applied onto an event model by the shared importer. Property names are PascalCase; deserialization is case-insensitive.

Id.description: The event model identifier. Ignored on import into an existing event model.

Collections.description: The module collections. Each collection becomes a grouping of modules on the canvas.

Concepts.description: The concepts the application declares - the strongly typed domain values everything else is written in terms of. Declared once for the whole application rather than per slice.

Policies.description: The policies the application declares - what the names a command's 'authorize' declaration refers to actually check.

ParentFeatureId.description: The parent feature, when this is a nested sub-feature.

SliceType.description: StateChange accepts a command and appends events; StateView projects events into a read model; Automation reacts and performs side effects; Translator reacts and appends follow-up events.

Reactions.description: The reactions declared within the slice - the behavior that runs when something happens.

Screens.description: The screens declared within the slice - which read models the slice's user interface shows, and which commands it offers.

Captures.description: The captures declared within the slice - the translations of external sources into events.

SourceEventId.description: Empty when the event is owned by this slice; otherwise the id of the event this one references (a State Change slice's event referenced by a consumer slice).

Schema.description: The event payload as a JSON Schema string.

Tags.description: The tags declared on the event, applied to every append of it.

Schema.description: The command payload as a JSON Schema string.

StateSchema.description: The command's state (DCB) schema as a JSON Schema string.

Produces.description: The events the command appends, in declaration order.

Identifier.description: The name of the command property whose value identifies the event source the command appends to. Null when the command declares none, in which case every execution opens a stream of its own.

Authorization.description: What the caller must satisfy to execute the command; null when the command declares none and anyone may execute it.

Requirements.description: The conditions the command as a whole must satisfy - the modeled 'require' rules.

Reads.description: The read models the command consults before it decides - the modeled 'reads' declarations.

AuthorizationRequirement.description: What an 'authorize' declaration requires of the caller. Discriminated by 'kind': 'policy' names one policy, 'logical' combines two requirements. A tree rather than a flat list of names, because a flat list cannot distinguish 'A or B and C' from '(A or B) and C'.

Policy.description: Policy only - the name of the referenced policy.

Operator.description: Logical only - the operator combining the requirements.

Requirement.description: A rule the command as a whole must satisfy - the modeled 'require' rule. Carries the same condition tree a 'produces when' guard carries.

Message.description: The message reported when the condition does not hold; null when none is declared.

ReadsDefinition.description: A read model the command consults before it decides - the modeled 'reads' declaration.

ReadModel.description: The name of the read model the command reads.

By.description: The command property the read model is looked up by; null when the read model is not keyed.

ProducedEvent.description: An event the command appends - the modeled 'produces' declaration.

Event.description: The name of the event type to append.

When.description: The condition guarding the production; null when the event is always produced.

For.description: Where the event source this event is appended to comes from - the modeled 'for' clause. Null when the event lands on the command's own event source.

ProducedEventSource.description: Where the event source a produced event is appended to comes from. Carries no property name, unlike ProducedEventProperty: the value identifies the stream rather than filling a property of the payload.

Expression.description: The source, interpreted according to Kind.

ProducedEventProperty.description: How one property of a produced event gets its value.

Property.description: The name of the property on the event payload.

Expression.description: The source, interpreted according to Kind - a command property name, JSON literal text, an identity path, an environment variable name or a template.

ProducedEventCondition.description: The condition guarding a produced event. Discriminated by 'kind': 'comparison' compares a command property against a constant, 'logical' combines two conditions.

Property.description: Comparison only - the command property being compared.

Value.description: Comparison only - the constant compared against, as JSON text.

CommandPropertyRules.description: Validation rules for a single command property.

RuleDefinition.description: A single validation rule. Discriminated by 'kind' (e.g. notEmpty, minLength, maxLength, emailAddress, matches, greaterThan).

Schema.description: The read model as a JSON Schema string.

ProjectionDefinition.description: How the read model is projected from events. Dictionary values are keyed by event type / property path.

GivenReadModels.description: The read model states that establish the Given precondition.

ThenReadModels.description: The read model states expected in the Then step - what a ThenReadModel run step verifies.

Values.description: The event values as a JSON string.

SpecificationReadModel.description: A read model state in a specification - used for both the Given precondition and the Then expectation.

Values.description: The read model values as a JSON string.
The command values as a JSON string.

ConceptDefinition.description: A concept the application declares - a strongly typed domain value.

Type.description: The primitive type the concept is based on, or 'Enum' for an enumeration.

Values.description: The values of the concept when it is an enumeration; empty otherwise.

ConceptAttribute.description: An attribute declared on a concept, such as '@pii' or '@sensitive', with the reason declared for it.

Name.description: The name of the attribute, without the '@' prefix.

Reason.description: The reason declared with it; empty when none was declared.

PolicyDefinition.description: A policy the application declares - the named authorization rule an 'authorize' declaration refers to by name.

Condition.description: What the policy requires; null when it states no condition, which is the case for one implemented in code.

CodeLanguage.description: The language tag of the inline code block implementing the policy; empty when the policy states its condition declaratively. Only the tag is carried, never the code.

PolicyCondition.description: What a policy requires of the caller. Discriminated by 'kind': 'authenticated' requires only a signed-in caller, 'role' a named role, 'claim' a claim value, 'logical' combines two conditions. A tree rather than a flat list, because a flat list cannot distinguish 'A or B and C' from '(A or B) and C'.

Role.description: Role only - the name of the required role.

Claim.description: Claim only - the name of the claim the caller must carry.

MatchesSubject.description: Claim only - whether the claim is matched against the subject rather than against Value.

Value.description: Claim only - the value the claim is matched against, interpreted according to ValueKind. Empty when matched against the subject.

Operator.description: Logical only - the operator combining the conditions.

ReactionDefinition.description: A reaction declared within a slice - behavior that runs when something happens.

Description.description: What the reaction does; empty when none is declared.

Where.description: The condition narrowing which occurrences run the reaction; null when every occurrence does.

ReactionTrigger.description: One trigger clause of a reaction - what sets it off, and what it does when set off.

Data.description: The names of the values of the occurrence the reaction uses.

File.description: The relative path of the file holding the implementation; empty when the implementation is not in a file. The path is carried, the code is not.

ReactionTriggerSource.description: What causes a reaction to run. Discriminated by 'kind': 'named' is an event or a declared trigger, 'interval' runs on an interval, 'schedule' runs at a time of day.

Name.description: Named only - the name of the event or trigger.

Amount.description: Interval only - how many units pass between runs.

Time.description: Schedule only - the time of day the reaction runs at.

DayOfWeek.description: Schedule only - the day of the week it runs on; null when it runs every day.

DayOfMonth.description: Schedule only - the day of the month it runs on; null when it runs every day.

InvokedCommand.description: A command a reaction dispatches - the modeled 'invokes' declaration. Kept apart from ProducedEvent because a command is not produced but asked for, and may still be rejected.

ScreenDefinition.description: A screen declared within a slice - which read models it shows, and which commands it offers. The presentation structure of a screen is a parallel output (Cratis.Scene.Model), not part of this one.

File.description: The relative path of the file the screen lives in; empty when the screen is declared inline.

ScreenDataBinding.description: A read model a screen binds to - the modeled 'data' directive.

Query.description: The name of the query providing the data.

By.description: The parameter the query is keyed by; null when it is not keyed.

ScreenAction.description: A command a screen exposes - the modeled 'action' directive.

NavigatesTo.description: The screen navigated to once the action succeeds; null when it navigates nowhere.

CaptureDefinition.description: A capture declared within a slice - the translation of an external source into events.

Key.description: The source property identifying an instance.

CaptureSource.description: Where a capture reads from. The kind stays the text the document wrote rather than becoming an enumeration, because the set of sources is open.

Kind.description: The kind of source, such as 'api', 'webhook' or 'message'.

CaptureSourceSetting.description: A single setting of a capture source, such as 'route /invoices' or 'poll 5m'.

Value.description: The verbatim value of the setting.

CaptureMapOperation.description: One operation in a capture's 'map' body. Discriminated by 'kind': 'mapping' fills one property from a source value, 'split' fills several from one.

Source.description: The source, interpreted according to SourceKind.

Separator.description: Split only - the separator the value is split by.

Targets.description: Split only - the target properties receiving the parts, in order.

CaptureTranslation.description: A single value translation within a mapping, such as '"utkast" => draft'.

CaptureAppend.description: An event a capture appends - the modeled 'append' declaration.

When.description: What makes the append happen; null when the capture appends on every change it observes.

CaptureTrigger.description: What makes a capture append happen - the modeled 'when' clause.

Expression.description: The template expression that must evaluate to true.

CaptureChildren.description: A 'children' block of a capture - changes within a child collection of the source.

IdentifiedBy.description: The property identifying a child instance.

CaptureNested.description: A 'nested' block of a capture - a single nullable child object of the source.
